description: Test file for MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) functionalities in Mattermost, including secret generation, activation, deactivation, token validation, and issuer extraction.

methods.name: TestGenerateSecret
methods.description: Tests the generation of MFA secrets, including failure and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestGetIssuerFromURL
methods.description: Tests extraction and escaping of issuer from various URL inputs.

methods.name: TestActivate
methods.description: Tests MFA activation process, including token validation, store updates, and prevention of token reuse.

methods.name: TestDeactivate
methods.description: Tests MFA deactivation process, ensuring secrets and active status are cleared.

methods.name: TestValidateToken
methods.description: Tests validation of MFA tokens, including format errors, reuse prevention, and successful validation.

methods.name: TestRandomBase32String
methods.description: Tests the randomness and length of generated base32 strings.
